A porta cabin is a factory-built steel cabin used as a site office, security post, storage room, or worker unit. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures steel porta cabins at its Bangalore factory and dispatches them to Chennai by road along the NH-48 corridor, with most ready units reaching the city in 1–2 working days. For Chennai's industrial belts at Ambattur, Sriperumbudur, and Oragadam, that short transit means a finished cabin arrives on site quickly, ready to place and use.

Why Chennai Buyers Choose SAMAN

SAMAN is a direct manufacturer, not a reseller. We started in 2009 and incorporated as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd in 2019, and we build every cabin in-house under ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 management systems, with NSIC government-purchase enlistment and DPIIT startup recognition. Buying factory-direct means you deal with the people who build the cabin, customise it, and stand behind it — not a middleman adding margin. Explore our full range of porta cabin products, all built to the same manufacturing standard.

Our Bangalore plant sits roughly 335–360 km from Chennai along NH-48. For industrial zones west and south-west of the city, like Sriperumbudur and Oragadam, the run is often shorter than reaching central Chennai. Standard delivery is ₹3,000 with 3–5 day transit nationally; for Chennai the road movement itself is usually a single day once loaded, and we coordinate crane or hydraulic unloading at your site.

Porta Cabin Demand Across Chennai

Chennai's industrial geography drives steady porta cabin demand, and the right cabin depends on where you are in the city.

The large manufacturing belt at Oragadam (602118), Sriperumbudur (602105), and Maraimalai Nagar (603209) — one of South India's densest industrial corridors, packed with large factories and their vendor units — needs project site offices, vendor cabins, security posts at gates, and storage units during plant and warehouse construction. These run off NH-48 and the GST Road corridor.

The SME manufacturing estates at Ambattur (600058) and Guindy (600032) — engineering shops, fabrication units, and machine works — use compact office cabins, kiosks, and guard cabins that fit tight estate plots.

The OMR commercial corridor through Perungudi (600096), Sholinganallur (600119), and Siruseri (603103) drives demand for facility offices, security posts, and temporary project offices during commercial fit-outs.

The north Chennai port and logistics belt at Manali (600068) and Ennore, with heavy industrial, port, and logistics activity, uses security cabins, port-side site offices, and contractor storage units.

If your site sits in any of these zones, we can advise the cabin size and fit-out that suits the work and the plot.

Porta Cabin Types for Chennai Buyers

Most Chennai enquiries fall into four cabin types, and the right one depends on the job. An office cabin is a finished workspace — insulated walls, vinyl flooring, lighting, fan and socket points, and AC provision — used as a project office, sales counter, or site administration room. A site office cabin is the same idea built for active sites: on construction projects at Oragadam, Sriperumbudur, or along the OMR corridor, it gives engineers and supervisors a clean, lockable base from day one and moves to the next project when the work is done.

A security cabin or guard cabin is a compact unit, often 6×6 ft to 8×6 ft, placed at a gate or boundary for a single guard. With a window, grills, and a fan point, it suits factory gates in the Ambattur and Guindy estates and apartment, warehouse, or campus entrances across the city.

A storage cabin is a closed, weather-resistant steel room for tools, materials, or site documents. A worker or labour unit is built for accommodation or rest, with ventilation and hard-wearing flooring for daily use — common on the larger project sites in the port and logistics belt at Manali and Ennore, where work runs in shifts.

Porta Cabin Sizes and Build

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, with the panel and fit-out matched to the use:

ComponentSpecification
FrameMS steel structure to IS 2062
Wall & roof panelsSandwich / PUF insulated panels or cement board
FlooringPlywood with vinyl, or chequered sheet for heavy use
Doors & windowsSteel/aluminium door, sliding windows with grills
ElectricalLight, fan, and socket points wired to a DB
OptionsAC provision, toilet/washroom, partition, extra windows

Our standard MS porta cabin sizes run from compact 10×10 ft guard cabins up to 20 ft and 40 ft office units, and we build to your required dimensions. Exact panel grades and fittings are confirmed at quotation against your drawing.

Customisation for Your Site

You choose the layout and fit-out: single open office or partitioned rooms, toilet or pantry, AC, extra electrical points, window placement, and exterior colour. Security cabins can be built compact for a single guard at a gate; site offices can be sized for a project team with a meeting space. Tell us the use and we configure the cabin around it. Share a rough sketch or even a photo of the plot, and we can suggest a layout that fits the access and the work on the ground.

What Sets the Price

A porta cabin's price depends on real factors, not a flat rate: the size, the wall panel type (PUF vs cement board), the flooring grade, insulation, the number of electrical points, AC or toilet provision, and the transport distance to your Chennai zone. A compact guard cabin and a fitted 40 ft office sit at very different price points. We quote against your actual size and fit-out rather than a vague figure — share your requirement and you get a clear number.

Delivery and Installation to Chennai

Your cabin is fabricated at our Bangalore factory and dispatched by road via NH-48. Ready units typically move in a single day once loaded; allowing 1–2 days accounts for loading, traffic, check-posts, site access, and crane coordination. On arrival we offload by crane or hydraulic system and place the unit on your prepared base. Confirm your site has firm, level ground and clear vehicle access before delivery day. If your access is tight or the gate is narrow, tell us in advance so we can plan the right vehicle and offloading method for the spot.

FAQs: Porta Cabin in Chennai

How long does delivery to Chennai take?

A ready cabin usually moves from our Bangalore factory to Chennai in 1–2 working days by road via NH-48. Custom-built units depend on the fit-out; we confirm a date at order.

What does a porta cabin cost in Chennai?

It depends on size, panel type, flooring, insulation, electrical points, and any AC or toilet provision. A compact guard cabin and a fitted office cabin are priced very differently. Share your size and use and we quote against it.

What sizes are available?

From compact 10×10 ft guard cabins to 20 ft and 40 ft office units, plus custom dimensions built to your drawing.

Can I rent a porta cabin in Chennai instead of buying?

We are a manufacturer focused on built-to-order supply. Tell us your requirement and timeline and we will advise the best option for your project.

Do I need to prepare the site before delivery?

Yes — firm, level ground and clear access for the delivery vehicle and crane. We guide you on base preparation when you order.

Are the cabins suitable for Chennai's coastal weather?

The MS frame to IS 2062 with insulated panels and a galvanised or coated finish handles Chennai's heat and humidity, with a 20–25 year engineered service life.

SAMAN delivers across South India from the same Bangalore factory. If your work spans more than one city, see our guides to porta cabin in Hyderabad and porta cabins in Bangalore for local delivery and site details.

Get Your Porta Cabin in Chennai

Tell us your site zone, size, and use, and we will recommend the cabin and quote against your requirement. Call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440 for Bangalore and South India, and +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 for Delhi NCR and North India, or send an enquiry.
